review_candidates.title: Consultant, Enterprise Backup & Recovery
review_candidates.description: What do you think of when you hear the name MNP? We are more than a prominent consulting firm in tax and accounting, we are redefining how organizations succeed in the digital age by bridging strategic vision, technical innovation, and operational execution to deliver transformative results. Make an impact as we strengthen our Managed Services practice in the role of Consultant, Enterprise Backup & Recovery. Join a diverse team of tech-savvy problem solvers dedicated to supporting clients across Canada with innovative collaboration technologies and scalable IT solutions. The ideal candidate would be the technical authority responsible for the design, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of backup, and recovery solutions across managed client environments. This role serves as the highest escalation point for backup-related incidents and recovery operations, providing expertise in Veeam and Acronis technologies while ensuring client data is protected, recoverable, and aligned with business continuity objectives. It also works closely with Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, and Project teams to develop resilient backup architectures, validate recovery capabilities, implement best practices, and mitigate risks associated with data loss, ransomware, and system outages. The successful candidate combines deep technical expertise, strong troubleshooting skills, and a customer-focused mindset to deliver reliable data protection services and ensure successful recovery outcomes for clients. MNP Digital is Canada's leading consulting and technology partner, delivering innovative solutions that help organizations thrive in a rapidly changing world. Join a collaborative team that embraces innovation, values professional growth, and empowers you to make an impact. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical escalation point for all backup, recovery, and disaster recovery incidents related to Veeam and Acronis platforms. Design, implement, and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions for client environments. Perform advanced troubleshooting of failed backups, replication jobs, recovery operations, and storage-related issues. Conduct backup health reviews, capacity planning, and optimization assessments. Validate backup integrity through regular recovery testing and disaster recovery exercises. Develop and maintain backup standards, policies, procedures, and deployment documentation. Lead onboarding and migration projects involving backup platform deployment and modernization. Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Service Desk teams to ensure data protection requirements are met. Perform root cause analysis on backup failures and recurring issues. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Service Desk and Infrastructure teams. Manage vendor escalations with Veeam, Acronis, Microsoft, storage vendors, and cloud providers. Ensure backup environments meet client retention, compliance, and business continuity requirements. Create and maintain knowledge base articles and operational documentation. Participate in change management and major incident processes. Monitor backup platform health and proactively address risks and capacity concerns. Skills And Experience 5–10 years of experience supporting enterprise backup and recovery platforms. Experience within an MSP or multi-client environment. Proven experience designing and supporting backup solutions for: Microsoft 365 Windows Servers VMware vSphere Hyper-V Azure workloads Physical servers and endpoints Advanced knowledge of: Veeam Backup & Replication Veeam Service Provider Console Veeam Cloud Connect Veeam Data Cloud for 365 Acronis Cyber Protect Acronis Management Console Acronis Disaster Recovery Microsoft 365 Backup solutions Experience with: PowerShell scripting Backup reporting and analytics Capacity planning Monitoring and alerting systems API integrations Soft Skills: Strong communication (able to explain IT issues in non-technical terms). Customer service mindset with patience and empathy. Team player, able to collaborate with other Service Desk resources. Problem-solving and analytical thinking. Willingness to learn and grow into Microsoft specialist roles. Strong time management. Attention to detail. Understanding of the importance of detailed time tracking and recording. Bilingual (English/French) considered an asset. Required Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation Veeam Backup & Replication Technical Certification (VMCE or equivalent current certification) Acronis Cyber Protect Technical Certification Recommended Certification Track: Acronis Certified Engineer MyRewards@MNP More than a paycheque, MNP is proud to offer customized rewards for our team members. With a focus on health and wealth, we provide an extensive list of benefits that support our unique culture and foster work-life integration. Our MyRewards@MNP program offers benefits that allow you to thrive at work and outside of the office. Be rewarded with generous paid time off including 4 personal days, firm sponsored social events, a group pension plan with 4% matching contribution, voluntary savings products, bonus program eligibility, a wellness subsidy, health and dental benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, learning opportunities through MNP University, a flexible ‘Dress For Your Day’ environment and more! This is a current opportunity with an ideal hiring range of between $70,000 to $85,000 based on skills and experience level. Diversity@MNP We embrace diversity as a core value and celebrate our differences. We believe each team member contributes unique gifts and amplifying their potential makes our business stronger. We encourage people with disabilities to apply!

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. Our innovative solutions support the development and application of practical, cost-effective systems that meet our customers’ challenges – from routine to extreme. Our experience and expertise across multiple industries uniquely positions us as a leader in the government, space, and maritime services markets. Our products and services meet the rigorous demands of the complex environments in which they operate, delivering results without compromising safety or reliability.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Cyber Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: About InterDigital InterDigital is a global research and development company focused primarily on wireless, video, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and related technologies. We design and develop foundational technologies that enable connected, immersive experiences in a broad range of communications and entertainment products and services. We license our innovations worldwide to companies providing such products and services, including makers of wireless communications devices, consumer electronics, IoT devices, cars and other motor vehicles, and providers of cloud-based services such as video streaming. As a leader in wireless technology, our engineers have designed and developed a wide range of innovations that are used in wireless products and networks, from the earliest digital cellular systems to 5G and today’s most advanced Wi-Fi technologies. We are also a leader in video processing and video encoding/decoding technology, with a significant AI research effort that intersects with both wireless and video technologies. Founded in 1972, InterDigital is listed on Nasdaq. InterDigital is a registered trademark of InterDigital, Inc. For more information, visit: www.interdigital.com. Summary InterDigital is seeking a Senior Cyber Security Engineer to strengthen enterprise security capabilities across infrastructure, cloud, applications, data, AI, and R&D environments. This role will support security engineering, governance, risk and compliance, identity and access management, and emerging technology protection. This role is ideal for a senior security professional who can balance hands-on engineering with forward-looking security strategy, helping shape scalable security practices across InterDigital’s enterprise and R&D environments. This role will report to the Sr Director, Head of Cybersecurity & Networking Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain security solutions across enterprise, cloud, AI, IAM, and hybrid environments. Support GRC activities, including risk assessments, control validation, policy alignment, audits, and security framework adoption. Partner with IT, R&D, engineering, and business teams to identify risks and recommend practical security improvements. Support security reviews for R&D initiatives, AI-enabled systems, applications, platforms, and emerging technologies. Contribute to threat modeling, vulnerability management, incident response, identity governance, and access control improvements. Evaluate emerging threats, tools, and technologies to improve InterDigital’s security posture. Develop security standards, architecture patterns, documentation, and roadmap inputs. Mentor team members and provide technical leadership on security projects. Qualifications Strong experience in cyber security engineering, enterprise security, cloud security, IAM, GRC, or infrastructure security. Expert level knowledge of AI security concepts, identity and access management, network security, endpoint security, vulnerability management, and incident response. Experience supporting research, engineering, or technology-driven environments is preferred. Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, SOC 2, or related standards. Ability to communicate security risks and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to collaborate across IT, R&D, engineering, and business teams. Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience; relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, GSEC, GIAC, AWS/Azure Security, or similar are preferred. Location : Conshohocken, PA. We are open to one of our InterDigital locations in France. InterDigital is an equal employment opportunity employer. InterDigital will not engage in or tolerate unlawful discrimination with regard to any employment decision, policy or practice based on a person’s sex, gender, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), age, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military status, veteran status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, assignments, evaluations, coaching, promotion, discipline, discharge and layoff. À propos d’InterDigital InterDigital est une société de recherche et développement d’envergure mondiale, principalement axée sur les technologies sans fil, la vidéo, l’intelligence artificielle (« IA ») et les technologies associées. Nous concevons et développons des technologies fondamentales qui rendent possibles des expériences connectées et immersives dans un large éventail de produits et services de communication et de divertissement. Nous concédons sous licence nos innovations dans le monde entier à des entreprises proposant ces produits et services, notamment les fabricants d’appareils de communication sans fil, l’électronique grand public, les objets connectés (IoT), les voitures et autres véhicules à moteur, ainsi que les fournisseurs de services cloud tels que la diffusion vidéo en streaming. En tant que leader des technologies sans fil, nos ingénieurs ont conçu et développé un large éventail d’innovations utilisées dans les produits et réseaux sans fil, des premiers systèmes cellulaires numériques à la 5G et aux technologies Wi-Fi les plus avancées d’aujourd’hui. Nous sommes également un acteur de premier plan dans le traitement de la vidéo et les technologies d’encodage/décodage vidéo, avec un effort de recherche important en IA qui recoupe à la fois les technologies sans fil et vidéo. Fondée en 1972, InterDigital est cotée au Nasdaq. InterDigital est une marque déposée d’InterDigital, Inc. Pour en savoir plus, consultez : www.interdigital.com. Résumé InterDigital recherche un ingénieur senior en cybersécurité (Senior Cyber Security Engineer) pour renforcer les capacités de sécurité de l’entreprise dans les domaines de l’infrastructure, du cloud, des applications, des données, de l’IA et des environnements de R&D. Ce poste couvre l’ingénierie de sécurité, la gouvernance, les risques et la conformité, la gestion des identités et des accès, ainsi que la protection des technologies émergentes. Il s’adresse idéalement à un professionnel confirmé de la sécurité, capable de conjuguer une pratique technique de terrain avec une stratégie de sécurité tournée vers l’avenir, afin de contribuer à façonner des pratiques de sécurité évolutives dans les environnements d’entreprise et de R&D d’InterDigital. Ce poste est rattaché au directeur senior, responsable de la cybersécurité et des réseaux. Responsabilités Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des solutions de sécurité dans les environnements d’entreprise, cloud, IA, de gestion des identités et des accès (IAM) et hybrides. Contribuer aux activités de gouvernance, risques et conformité (GRC), y compris les évaluations des risques, la validation des contrôles, l’alignement des politiques, les audits et l’adoption de cadres de sécurité. Collaborer avec les équipes informatiques, R&D, ingénierie et métier pour identifier les risques et recommander des améliorations de sécurité concrètes. Participer aux revues de sécurité des initiatives de R&D, des systèmes basés sur l’IA, des applications, des plateformes et des technologies émergentes. Contribuer à la modélisation des menaces, à la gestion des vulnérabilités, à la réponse aux incidents, à la gouvernance des identités et à l’amélioration du contrôle des accès. Évaluer les menaces, outils et technologies émergents afin d’améliorer la posture de sécurité d’InterDigital.
